issue.title: Eliminate existing bob-cli clippy warnings
issue.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-t.1 during epic verification. On current master 2037307,  exits 0 but reports three existing warnings: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, and question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Apply the behavior-preserving idiomatic rewrites, retain focused coverage, and require the full clippy command to complete without these diagnostics.

fields.description: Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-t.1 during epic verification. On current master 2037307, cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format short exits 0 but reports three existing warnings: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, and question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Apply the behavior-preserving idiomatic rewrites, retain focused coverage, and require the full clippy command to complete without these diagnostics.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced by the bob-cli-12 land agent on master 9258da9 (Rust/clippy 1.98.0): 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features' exits 0 but now reports FIVE warnings, two more than this bead's original three. Still present: collapsible_if at src/native/plugins.rs:782 and :814, question_mark at src/native/projects.rs:2298. Newly appeared since 2037307: chunks_exact_to_as_chunks at src/native/dataview.rs:2372 (suggests as_chunks::<2>().0) and at src/native/task_status_hooks.rs:1402 (suggests as_chunks::<2>().0.iter()). Impact: 'just lint' output is noisy enough that a genuinely new warning is easy to miss during epic verification -- I had to diff locations by hand to confirm none of the five came from the capture-grammar work in bob-cli-12. Please widen the fix to all five and consider gating with -D warnings so the count cannot drift again.

Independently reproduced by bob-cli-2f.land (proposed by bob-cli-2f.6 and bob-cli-2f.7) on master f8b03c2 + landing fix: 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features' now reports 17 lib warnings (18 lib-test) plus 1 cli-test warning, up from the 5 in the last +1. The count is identical to pre-split base c603111; bob-cli-2f moved the code verbatim, so several locations changed: collapsible_if src/native/plugins.rs:780,:812 and src/native/capture/output.rs:361; question_mark src/native/projects/scan.rs:215 and src/native/capture/pomodoro_adjust.rs:613; too_many_arguments src/native/capture/plan.rs:79, capture/pomodoro_insert.rs:196, task_status_groups/emit.rs:118; needless_return src/native/capture_language/tokens.rs:929,:974; int_plus_one src/native/capture_task_toggle.rs:368,:856; manual_rem_euclid capture/pomodoro_adjust.rs:968; redundant_locals task_status_hooks/sync.rs:268; unnecessary_map_or capture/pomodoro_start.rs:377; derivable_impls vault_sync.rs:146; ptr_arg capture_active_tasks.rs:308; single_element_loop src/native/capture_parse.rs:1033; unnecessary_to_owned tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_shift.rs:581. Impact: during the bob-cli-2f landing I had to run clippy on a base worktree and diff by hand to prove that only 3 unused_import warnings were new. The separate deny-level '|| true' error is not in scope here; bob-cli-28 owns it.

Independently reproduced by bob-cli-2k.land (proposed by phase bob-cli-2k.2) on master b3405bd: 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features' reports 17 lib warnings (18 lib-test, 17 of them duplicates) plus 1 cli-test warning. That is the same count as the bob-cli-2f +1, so epic bob-cli-2k (=x<N>!<M> close selection) added none. The kinds are unchanged: collapsible_if x3, too_many_arguments x3, needless_return x2 (capture_language/tokens.rs), int_plus_one x2, question_mark x2, ptr_arg, unnecessary_to_owned, unnecessary_map_or, derivable_impls, redundant_locals, manual_rem_euclid, single_element_loop. Impact: every epic landing still has to diff clippy output by hand to prove it added no warnings. The separate deny-level '|| true' error is owned by bob-cli-28.

Independently reproduced by bob-cli-2n.land (proposed by phase bob-cli-2n.5) on master 42cd336 with rustc/clippy 1.95.0: 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features' reports 17 lib warnings plus the cli-test single_element_loop at src/native/capture_parse.rs:1117 ('for raw in ["Plan =x"]', blame d2239267). Same count and kinds as the bob-cli-2k +1, so epic bob-cli-2n (named/linked project tasks) added none; locations moved slightly (needless_return now src/native/capture_language/tokens.rs:1226,:1306; collapsible_if capture/output.rs:385; ptr_arg capture_active_tasks.rs:311). Impact: bob-cli-2n.5 misread the single_element_loop warning as the lint failure, and every landing still diffs clippy output by hand. The deny-level '|| true' error remains owned by bob-cli-28.

Independently reproduced by bob-cli-2o.land on master 090e3eb: 'cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features --message-format short' reports 20 distinct warning locations plus the bob-cli-28 deny (proposed as a follow-up by bob-cli-2o.9, citing pomodoro_shift.rs:581). git blame shows exactly one of them comes from epic bob-cli-2o (manual_contains at src/native/capture_complete.rs:1372, commit 35b96b3), and the bob-cli-2o closeout tale fixes that one; the rest predate bob-cli-2o. Impact: the noisy baseline makes new warnings easy to miss during epic verification.

Independently reproduced by bob-cli-2y.land (proposed by phase bob-cli-2y.12, which cited tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_shift.rs:581) on master 297ecb4: 'cargo clippy --lib --bins --all-features --message-format short' reports 19 lib warning locations plus the cli-test unnecessary_to_owned at tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_shift.rs:581 (a warning, not the deny). git blame shows exactly one lib warning comes from epic bob-cli-2y: dead_code reachable_identities at src/native/task_status_hooks/references.rs:409, orphaned by 33d5622; the bob-cli-2y closeout removes it. All others predate bob-cli-2y (same kinds as the bob-cli-2o +1). Impact: bob-cli-2y.12 misread the pomodoro_shift.rs warning as the lint failure, and every landing still diffs clippy output by hand.

Proposed by phase bob-cli-3a.3 during the bob-cli-3a landing. On bob-cli master d2aae45 the cli-test warning site is still tests/cli/capture/pomodoro_shift.rs:580-581 (git blame 7d1c8dd3): String::from_utf8_lossy(...).to_string() concatenated with another to_string(). That is the same unnecessary_to_owned warning earlier +1s named, not a new defect from the freshness-mark epic. The phase called it the just-lint error; the expression that actually fails clippy by default remains the separate '|| true' deny owned by epic bob-cli-28. Impact is unchanged: landings still have to separate this warning from a real new diagnostic.
